-- Package drafts (ADR-0082 row A6).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".package_drafts (
    kind       TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('map', 'app')),
    draft_id   TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (length(draft_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
    owner_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    written_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    record     JSON NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (kind, draft_id)
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_package_drafts_written
    ON "honua".package_drafts (kind, written_at, draft_id)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_package_drafts_expires
    ON "honua".package_drafts (expires_at)
COMMENT ON TABLE "honua".package_drafts IS 'Map and app package drafts readable by their owner on any node until expiry.'

-- MCP sessions and the requests running in them (ADR-0082 rows A7 to A9).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".mcp_sessions (
    session_id    TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(session_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
    principal_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    record        JSON NOT NULL,
    expires_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mcp_sessions_expires
    ON "honua".mcp_sessions (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".mcp_requests (
    session_id    TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES "honua".mcp_sessions (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    request_key   TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    principal_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    generation    TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    cancelled     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    expires_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, request_key)
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mcp_requests_principal
    ON "honua".mcp_requests (principal_key, expires_at)
COMMENT ON TABLE "honua".mcp_sessions IS 'MCP sessions every node accepts until idle expiry.'
COMMENT ON TABLE "honua".mcp_requests IS 'MCP requests running on any node, with their cancellation flag.'
